d: A.C.P. Ramakant Chaudhary, an uptight police officer, struggles with bringing his elder son's killers to justice. Vishal, his younger son, decides to take matters in his own hands.
When a newly-wed Aarti is assaulted by a gang of men, she is traumatised and her relationship with Vikas, her husband, is tested.

t: Bal Hanuman IV - Attack of the Universe
d: Chote Maharaj organises a kabaddi match between monkeys and crocodiles. However, the cunning crocodiles hatch a plan to revive the dreaded Demon crocodile king with the help of their new alien allies.
